entities.summary: Joel Armia is a Finnish professional ice hockey player who is a winger for the Los Angeles Kings of the National Hockey League (NHL). He was selected in the first round, 16th overall, by the Buffalo Sabres in the 2011 NHL entry draft. Armia has also previously played professionally for Porin Ässät of the SM-liiga as well as the Winnipeg Jets and Montreal Canadiens.
